purpose: Source-grounded development benchmark. No independent customer-pilot claim.

cases.question: Which receipt print type is normal for small receipt printers?
cases.evidence: Thermal is the normal choice for small receipt printers.

cases.question: Which receipt format is better for full-page invoices and office printers?
cases.evidence: Regular or A4 is better for full-page invoices and office printers.

cases.question: Should Auto Print stay on if the printer is not always connected?
cases.evidence: If the printer is not always connected, leave Auto Print off and train staff to print manually.

cases.question: How do I fix a receipt that prints too wide?
cases.evidence: Adjust print size and max characters in Receipt Print.

cases.question: Why is the customer missing from a receipt?
cases.evidence: Enable Print Customer and attach a customer to the sale.

cases.question: Why does Download PDF for an existing receipt need browser pop-ups?
cases.evidence: Download PDF opens a new tab. Allow pop-ups for the Posnic site when the browser blocks that tab.

cases.question: What does Same as SKU do to an item's barcode?
cases.evidence: Copies the SKU value into Barcode when the shop wants one code.

cases.question: Why would I add extra barcodes to one item?
cases.evidence: Lets multiple package codes find the same item.

alternatives.evidence: Use Extra barcodes for old labels, supplier pack codes or alternate package codes that should still find this item.

cases.question: Which GTIN EAN lengths does the client accept?
cases.evidence: The client accepts valid 8, 12, 13 or 14 digit trade codes

cases.question: Do sellable item variants need their own SKU and barcode?
cases.evidence: For variants, each sellable variant needs its own SKU and barcode.

cases.question: My scanner types numbers but the item is not found. What should I check?
cases.evidence: Barcode field does not match the printed code.

cases.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the command palette?
cases.evidence: Press Ctrl+K from any Posnic screen

alternatives.evidence: Ctrl+K is the exception and opens the command palette even from an input.

cases.question: How do I close the command palette without changing screens?
cases.evidence: Press Escape or select outside the palette to close it without changing screens.

cases.question: How many characters start item or customer record search in the command palette?
cases.evidence: A one-character query searches commands only; record search begins after two characters.

cases.question: How many item and customer suggestions does the palette return?
cases.evidence: Entity suggestions are permission-aware and return up to four items and four customers.

cases.question: Why is a page missing from my command palette?
cases.evidence: A missing page usually means the role lacks that module's read or write permission.

cases.question: What should I do if another user has the cash register open?
cases.evidence: Use another register or ask a manager to review/close the session.

alternatives.evidence: Open by another user | Another user has the open register session. | Do not sell on that drawer unless a manager resolves the session.

cases.question: What amount should a cashier enter as the Opening Float?
cases.evidence:
Count the cash already in the drawer.

Enter that amount as Opening Float.

cases.question: What happens to old register ids after changing branch?
cases.evidence: Old register ids are cleared and the new branch is checked.

cases.question: Can cashiers share one login across multiple drawers?
cases.evidence: Do not share one login across multiple drawers.

cases.question: Does Posnic perform cryptocurrency staking using register float?
Does Posnic control satellite weather radar automatically?
What is the owner's secret password?
Does Posnic guarantee a 73 percent revenue increase?
Is Quick Sale a stock-controlled catalog workflow?
cases.evidence: Quick Sale is for fast amount entry. Use it carefully because it is not a full stock-controlled catalog workflow.

cases.question: Should recurring Quick Sale lines stay as instant items?
cases.evidence: Move recurring Quick Sale lines into real items once they become common.

cases.question: Can Quick Sale replace stock items that need reorder points and supplier reporting?
cases.evidence: Do not use for stock-controlled items that need quantity tracking, reorder points, purchase costs, supplier reporting or barcode labels.

cases.question: Does parking a sale take payment or earn rewards?
cases.evidence: It reserves tracked stock, takes no payment or rewards, and can be resumed from the Parked or Recent Sales tab.

cases.question: Does a parked sale marked stale after 24 hours automatically release stock?
cases.evidence: A hold at least 24 hours old is visually marked stale. Stale is a review cue, not automatic cancellation or stock release.

cases.question: How many held bills are shown in the Parked list?
cases.evidence: The dedicated list is branch-scoped, newest first and limited to the latest 20 holds.

cases.question: Does creating a quotation reduce stock or record sales revenue?
cases.evidence: Creating or editing one does not collect payment, reduce stock or add sales revenue.

cases.question: How long is a new quotation valid by default?
cases.evidence: A new quotation defaults to seven days of validity unless the operator changes it.

cases.question: How can I quote installation work that is not in the catalog?
cases.evidence: Use Custom line for labor, installation, delivery or another quoted line that is not a catalog item.

cases.question: Should I create a negative new sale for a return?
cases.evidence: Search Sales History by the bill details; do not create a negative new sale.

cases.question: Can I return quantities already returned on the original bill?
cases.evidence: Posnic rejects zero, negative or already-returned quantities and prevents returning more than remains on the bill.

cases.question: Can a credit sale with a pending balance be returned immediately?
cases.evidence: A credit sale with a pending balance cannot be returned until its transaction is completed.

cases.question: Does cloning an item immediately save the duplicate?
cases.evidence: Clone creates an unsaved draft from an existing item.

cases.question: Can I clone an item instead of making a stock adjustment?
cases.evidence: it is not a shortcut for stock adjustments or a substitute for variants and batches.

cases.question: Should copied item values be accepted without review?
cases.evidence: Treat every visible value as a draft. Nothing should be accepted only because it came from the source item.

cases.question: Where do I create a service item with no stock?
cases.evidence: Menu path: Inventory -> Items -> New -> Standard item -> Service (no stock)

cases.question: Do Per hour and Per day service labels prove automatic time calculation?
cases.evidence: Posnic offers Fixed price, Per hour and Per day labels; verify the entered sale quantity and amount because the audited sale path does not prove automatic time calculation.

cases.question: Should a one-off counter amount become a reusable service catalog item?
cases.evidence: One-off amount at the counter | Quick Sale, when approved | Avoids filling the catalog with records that will not be reused.

cases.question: What happens to tracked stock when an item is deleted?
cases.evidence: Treat it as a manager action because tracked stock moves to zero and the deletion syncs to other devices.

cases.question: Should I delete an item when shelf stock is temporarily zero?
cases.evidence: Shelf stock is temporarily zero | Keep the item and receive or adjust stock.

cases.question: Can deleting an item correct a completed sale?
cases.evidence: A completed sale is wrong | Use Sales History or returns, not item deletion.

cases.question: Does This page export all filtered catalog items?
cases.evidence: This page exports only displayed rows; Everything matching the filter exports the full branch-scoped result behind the active search and filters.

cases.question: What is included by Everything matching the filter when no item filter is set?
cases.evidence: Everything matching the filter with no filter | All accessible items for the active branch.

cases.question: Which item export scope is suitable for only the rows currently visible?
cases.evidence: This page (what is shown) | Only item rows currently displayed on this list page.

cases.question: Is customer credit just a payment method?
cases.evidence: Customer credit is not just a payment method. It depends on shop settings, the customer profile and the sale payment state.

cases.question: Should Allow credit be turned on for every customer?
cases.evidence: Turn on Allow credit (pay later) only for approved customers.

cases.question: When should staff use unpaid or partial customer payment?
cases.evidence: Use unpaid or partial payment only when the customer and owner policy allow it.

cases.question: Does deleting a customer also remove their existing sales?
cases.evidence: Delete removes the customer card from the active customer list and picker. Existing sales stay on record.

cases.question: Can I restore a deleted customer from the Settings Recycle Bin?
cases.evidence: contact support for recovery because the current Customer deletion path does not feed the Settings Recycle Bin restore screen.

cases.question: Should a customer who owes money be deleted?
cases.evidence: Customer owes money | No | Settle or investigate the due before changing the master record.

cases.question: Which purchase order status can be deleted?
cases.evidence: Permanently removes that draft; only Draft is deletable.

cases.question: How should an Ordered purchase that will not proceed be handled?
cases.evidence: An Ordered document will not proceed | Cancel remaining | Preserves the document and changes it to Cancelled when nothing was received.

cases.question: Does placing or editing a purchase order receive stock?
cases.evidence: Goods have physically arrived | Receive | Creates receiving evidence and stock movement; placing or editing the order is not enough.

cases.question: Does Ordered purchase status add stock?
cases.evidence: Ordered records the supplier commitment without adding stock.

cases.question: What happens to stock when a purchase is marked Received?
cases.evidence: Received counts each inventory-tracked line into available quantity.

cases.question: Should goods awaiting inspection be marked Received merely to finish data entry?
cases.evidence: Goods arrived but inspection is incomplete | Keep Ordered under shop policy | Do not make unverified goods saleable merely to finish data entry.

cases.question: Can quick-created purchase items use pack conversion?
cases.evidence: do not use quick item creation for this workflow because quick-created items have no pack conversion.

cases.question: What should I verify after saving purchase pack fields?
cases.evidence: Save the item, reopen it and verify both pack fields before using them on a live delivery.

cases.question: In the purchase pack example, what is typed before selecting conversion?
cases.evidence: Packs delivered | 3 boxes | What the operator types before selecting the conversion control.

cases.question: Does closing a partial purchase short remove already received stock?
cases.evidence: It preserves quantities already received, moves no stock during the close, and records who closed the purchase and when.

cases.question: Which action closes a partial purchase when the remaining goods will not arrive?
cases.evidence: Some goods arrived and the supplier confirms the balance will not arrive | Cancel remaining | No new movement; already received stock stays.

cases.question: What supplier confirmation is needed before cancelling an undelivered balance?
cases.evidence: Obtain supplier confirmation that the outstanding balance is cancelled, unavailable or no longer required.

cases.question: What quantity do newly selected Inventory count rows start with?
cases.evidence: Every newly selected Inventory count row starts at zero, so enter and review each complete physical count before adjusting.

cases.question: Should found stock be entered as a fake supplier purchase?
cases.evidence: Sellable units were found but not in the POS count | Stock adjustment -> Stock found | A fake supplier purchase.

cases.question: Can a loss stock adjustment make stock negative?
cases.evidence: Loss | Qty lost: units missing | Entered quantity is subtracted; stock cannot fall below zero.

cases.question: Is there a one-click undo for Bulk Stock Update?
cases.evidence: Preview the scope first because a completed run has no one-click undo.

cases.question: When is applying one bulk stock formula appropriate?
cases.evidence: It is appropriate only when the same addition or removal genuinely applies to that whole set.

cases.question: Can bulk stock update record different physical counts for individual items?
cases.evidence: A physical count produced different final totals per item | Stock adjustment -> Inventory count | A bulk formula cannot represent individual counted totals.

cases.question: Can a 10 percent decrease undo a 10 percent price increase?
cases.evidence: a 10% increase followed by a 10% decrease leaves 99% of the starting price, before rounding.

cases.question: Is there a one-click undo in Price Settings?
cases.evidence: Price Settings has no one-click undo.

cases.question: What should I do if item prices changed after the bulk price Check?
cases.evidence: Cancel the decision, review the current controls and run Check again.

cases.question: Does a payment method label prove the money settled?
cases.evidence: Do not use a payment label as proof that the money settled; it is a classification that must be reconciled.

cases.question: Should I create duplicate payment labels for the same settlement account?
cases.evidence: Do not create duplicate labels for the same settlement account.

cases.question: When is a separate payment method label appropriate?
cases.evidence: Create a separate label only when the close process checks a separate drawer, machine or provider statement.

cases.question: What should I verify about the sum of split tender amounts?
cases.evidence: Check that the sum of method amounts equals the bill total.

cases.question: Should Split Payment stay enabled if close-time differences increase?
cases.evidence: Disable it again if close-time differences increase.

cases.question: What account check is needed for a card plus wallet payment?
cases.evidence: Card plus wallet | Confirm customer account before wallet use.

cases.question: Can I delete a system role?
cases.evidence: System roles cannot be deleted.

cases.question: Can a custom role assigned to users be deleted immediately?
cases.evidence: A role assigned to users cannot be deleted until users are reassigned.

cases.question: Does Sales write permission mean a cashier never needs manager approval?
cases.evidence: A cashier can have Sales write permission but still need manager approval for refunds, price overrides or register close.
